The skill said to prefer Gaia source IDs but none are provided in the paper for these early-type stars specifically. The paper mentions that many of these are from the Hypervelocity Star Survey. However, we need to fill candidate records with whatever information is available from the paper and its internal tables and text. The paper says: "In Tab. 1, we list all candidates which have P_bound<0.5. This list of candidates comprises 38 B/A dwarfs, one subdwarf O star, one F9 dwarf and one white dwarf." The Hypervelocity Star Survey contributed 32 stars, and they are named HVS1,4-10,12-24 and others. The "others" might be some that are not listed individually. For the named ones like HVS1, HVS4, etc., the paper does not give any specific kinematic data; all the data is in the external catalog.
